# Shot Data

> Production Data allows users to export Excel production reports from Final Cut Pro timelines.

The exported .xlsx workbook follows the standard Excel file format, so it opens directly in Apple's Numbers, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and other spreadsheet applications that support .xlsx files, without requiring any conversion.

## Case Study

- [Final Cut Pro's Enigma](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/case-study/final-cut-pro-enigma.md): Final Cut Pro stands out as a radically different NLE primarily because of its exclusive optimisation for the macOS ecosystem, leveraging seamless integration with Apple hardware and software.

## User Guide

- [Overview](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/user-guide/overview.md): Production Data has been meticulously crafted with a focus on simplicity, ensuring that users can execute tasks with minimal interaction. A central objective in its development has been reducing the number of clicks required for a seamless experience.
- [Extract](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/user-guide/extract.md): Extract Window
- [Notion Queue](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/user-guide/notion-queue.md): Notion Queue Window
- [General Settings](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/user-guide/general.md): General Settings
- [Configuration Settings](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/user-guide/configurations.md): Configuration Settings
- [Database Settings](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/user-guide/databases.md): Database Settings
- [Keyboard Shortcuts](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/user-guide/keyboard-shortcuts.md): You can use keyboard shortcuts to quickly accomplish Common tasks in Shot Data. To use a keyboard shortcut, press all the keys in the shortcut at the same time.
